title: Optimize / Evals review - 1:1 prep & follow-ups (weekly)
content:
Meeting: weekly 1:1 w/ Optimize / Evals review
Owner: Jamie Park (prep notes)
Date: 2026-03-04
Attendees (planned): Marco, Aisha, Priya, Jamie

Purpose: quick sync on recent eval runs, surface quality regressions, prioritize prompt-set triage & A/B follow-ups, define concrete action items before next run. Keep it 30 min.

Agenda (10/15/5 min split):
- Quick metrics snapshot (5–10m)
  - Highlight regressions by user-impacting buckets (hallucination, missing entity, wrong tone).
  - A/B top-level: vA (baseline) vs vB (prompt-relaxed + quant-ffnx) results.
- Deep-dive: top 3 regressions (10m)
  - Walk examples, reproduce steps, root-cause hypothesis.
- Triage & next steps (5–10m)
  - Who will run focused reruns, prompt edits, or rollback?
  - Confirm owners and deadlines.

Prep checklist (what I need to bring):
- Latest eval run summary (run id: eval-2026-03-02-17) -> linked above.
- Top 20 failing prompt ids + example model responses (csv exported).
- A/B test summary: key metrics and confidence intervals.
- List of recent infra/quant changes that could affect behavior (PR #842).
- Slack thread links where PM/customer reported regressions.

Quick metrics snapshot (from eval-2026-03-02-17):
- Dataset: internal prompt-sets (prod-like prompt mix, n=4.5k pairs)
- Primary metrics: exact-match-lenient, intent-f1, hallucination-rate (annotated)
- Baseline (vA) -> exact-match-lenient: 78.4% | intent-f1: 0.82 | hallucination-rate: 6.1%
- Variant (vB: prompt-relaxed + quant-ffnx) -> exact-match-lenient: 75.7% | intent-f1: 0.79 | hallucination-rate: 8.7%
- Delta (vB - vA): -2.7pp exact-match, -0.03 intent-f1, +2.6pp hallucination
- A/B significance: exact-match drop p=0.012 (bootstrap), hallucination increase p=0.004 -> likely real.

Top regressions (from aggregated fail list):
1) Missing entity extraction on banking prompts (n=143 failures, +45 vs baseline)
   - Example prompt id: bank-addr-0072 -> baseline returned structured entity: {account_type: savings} but vB omitted field or returned generic text.
   - Hypothesis: quantization + prompt-relaxed increased tokenization noise for long numeric sequences; KV-cache change in PR #842 may interact.
2) Tone/verbosity change on legal-summary prompts (n=98 failures)
   - Example prompt id: legal-sum-0021 -> vB produced more speculative language ("might be" instead of categorical statements).
   - Hypothesis: relaxed system prompt weighting leads to softer modal verbs. Possibly prompt-set anchor tokens are being truncated in batching.
3) Hallucination spike on knowledge-base QA (n=212 failures, large uptick)
   - Example prompt id: kb-qa-051 -> vB asserts facts that are not in KB excerpts.
   - Hypothesis: quantization-induced loss in precision for named-entity generation; also candidate reranking threshold lowered in A/B config.

Immediate reproduction steps (for triage):
- Marco: run focused reproduce job for bank-addr-0072 and 10 surrounding similar prompts with full model logits + topk traces (due 2026-03-06). Include exact seeds and config from eval run.
- Aisha: re-run legal-summary subset but force system prompt weight back to baseline for 100 examples to confirm prompt-weight hypothesis (due 2026-03-05).
- Priya: re-run kb-qa subset with baseline quantization profile but vB prompt-relaxed to isolate quant vs prompt (due 2026-03-06).

Short-term mitigation options (discuss in meeting):
- Roll back quant-ffnx profile in production for affected customer cohorts (requires infra coord, ETA ~ 4 hrs) -> discuss risk/benefit.
- Patch prompt templates to add explicit anchor tokens before critical sections (quick, low-risk for some prompt-sets).
- Tighten reranker threshold for KB QA A/B until we understand root cause.

Outstanding questions to raise in 1:1:
- Is PR #842 rolled to any dedicated pools? Which customer cohorts saw vB? (Marco to confirm)
- How many production requests map to our failing prompt-sets (approx estimate)? Need to quantify customer impact before rollbacks.
- Should we prioritize rollback or prompt fixes? (Tradeoffs: rollback is coarse but fast; prompt fixes are targeted but might be many).

Action items (concrete):
- Marco: reproduce bank-addr failures, collect logits & tokenization traces, open a short-run doc with findings (due 2026-03-06).
- Aisha: targeted prompt-weight rerun + write short note if hypothesis confirmed (due 2026-03-05).
- Priya: quant vs prompt isolation runs for KB QA and produce small matrix of results (due 2026-03-06).
- Jamie: prepare rollback runbook draft (steps, owner handoffs, communication plan for affected customers) and schedule rollback window if we choose to (due 2026-03-05).
- Everyone: add 3–5 representative failing examples to the shared csv with expected-correct outputs annotated (due 2026-03-06).

Notes to self / follow-ups after meeting:
- If reproduce confirms quant-loss, schedule immediate meeting with serving-runtime to discuss alternative quant profiles or mixed-precision header. Tag: eng-serving-runtime.
- If prompt-weight is the cause, push targeted prompt anchors via quick patch; check for side-effects on other prompt-sets (run small smoke eval).
- Update confluence page with summary & final decision and link to rollback runbook.

Rough prioritization (my call):
1) Reproduce and isolate (highest).
2) If quick rollback available and impact on production > 1% of traf volume -> rollback + deeper fix.
3) Otherwise, targeted prompt patches + monitor.

Backup notes / snippets to drop in meeting if needed:
- Small table: A/B top metrics (copy/paste)
  Metric | Baseline | Variant | Delta | p-val
  exact-match-lenient | 78.4% | 75.7% | -2.7pp | 0.012
  intent-f1 | 0.82 | 0.79 | -0.03 | 0.03
  hallucination-rate | 6.1% | 8.7% | +2.6pp | 0.004

- Example fail (bank-addr-0072):
  Prompt: "Extract account_type, account_number, routing_number from the text below:\n  \"Customer holds a savings account (Acct: 123456789) at Redwood Bank...\""
  Baseline: {account_type: "savings", account_number: "123456789", routing_number: "..."}
  Variant: "Customer holds an account at Redwood Bank"  <-- lost structured fields

- Short note for PM: attach this doc + top-10 fails before reaching out to affected customers.

Next meeting follow-up expected (by 2026-03-09): summary doc of reproductions + recommendation (rollback / patch / monitor).

TODO (quick):
- [ ] Attach reproducible run configs to shared csv (Jamie)
- [ ] Confirm which dedicated pools have vB (Marco)
- [ ] Draft rollback runbook (Jamie)

Status markers: this is a working doc / scratchpad; will convert to confluence summary once we have a clear recommended action.

-- end of notes (jamie)
